description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Ellakkala, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District (25/0211)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, owner registrations, and property details. It falls under the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land ownership, title settlement, and property registration under the Registration of Title Act, with no government personnel changes or structural administrative matters present.
